# Merge Conflict Resolution

This PR resolves merge conflicts from the previous PR by applying all changes to a fresh branch from main.

## Original PR
- Branch: `copilot/add-ci-and-health-check-workflows`
- Had merge conflicts with main

## This PR
- Branch: `copilot/fix-automation-merge-conflicts`
- Clean rebase from main (commit 6b6bbdd)
- All changes cherry-picked successfully
- No conflicts

## Changes Included
All 19 files from the original PR:
- 9 GitHub Actions workflows
- 4 issue templates
- 1 PR template
- 1 CODEOWNERS file
- 1 pre-commit config
- 2 documentation files
- README updates (badges)
- knowledge.json updates
